description: Fix contacts in the specified range. When a contact is fixed, its contact forces remain unchanged (frozen at current values) regardless of piece movements or contact state changes. This is useful for applying constant contact forces or boundary conditions, or for temporarily freezing contact forces during specific simulation phases. By default, only mechanical contacts are considered.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('contact fix <bval> range ...') - Python SDK does not provide direct contact fix functionality. No contact.fix() method exists in the SDK.
notes: Contact force values can be read via contact.force_global(), contact.force_local(), etc., but fixing forces must be done via command interface.
Fixed contact forces remain constant regardless of piece movements
Forces are frozen at their values when 'fix on' is executed
Normal force calculation is suspended for fixed contacts
Contact model logic still runs but cannot change forces
Use 'fix off' or 'contact free' to restore normal force calculation
More efficient than Python iteration for bulk fixing
Fixing does not prevent contact deletion by contact detection
Typically used for boundary conditions or special analyses
Related commands: ball fix, wall fix, contact property, contact model, contact free
fix on freezes all force components at their current values until fix off; the model still evaluates but cannot update them. Unfixing can make forces jump to match the current configuration.

examples.description: Fix contacts in x-position range 1.1 to 1.9 (from official example)
examples.use_case: Apply constant forces from boundary contacts

examples.description: Fix contacts with gap between 0 and 100 (from official example)
examples.use_case: Freeze forces for contacts in specific gap range

examples.description: Unfix all contacts, restore normal force calculation
examples.use_case: Return to dynamic force calculation after fixed phase

examples.command: contact fix on range contact type 'ball-facet'
contact fix true mechanical range contact active
contact fix off range model linearpbond
examples.description: Unfix linearpbond contacts, restore dynamic bonding forces
examples.use_case: Re-enable force calculation for bond contacts
